name: munjip-metrics
title: Munjip Metrics
description: Korean literary collections (Hanguk munjip chonggan, 1,249 collections) counted work by work: sizes, genre composition, relationship genres, authors. No text is included; works link to the ITKC database.

licenses.name: CC-BY-4.0
licenses.title: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (this site's derived tables)

sources.title: Institute for the Translation of Korean Classics, 'Hanguk munjip chonggan' (data.go.kr dataset 3074298, no license restriction): 1,249 XML archives adopted from the 1,251 portal entries (one without an attachment and one old-schema edition excluded), one per collection — a bibliographic file (author, series volume, publication year, table of contents, short introduction) plus one file per fascicle with every work's title, writer, genre class and text. Counted at the work level (type="최종정보").
